CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository hosts the Community Applications template for **Domestique**: a boutique PVR for bike racing, built on the same idea as Sonarr/Radarr but specifically for how race footage actually gets released (multi-part stages, the same race re-released by different broadcasters, trackers that name every file slightly differently). It watches a downloads folder (via a Transmission webhook, a watched hot folder, or a direct upload) and automatically files finished race downloads into a clean, Plex-ready library.
Also includes a password-gated web UI for managing show/event definitions and testing the file-name matcher, optional Plex partial-scan refresh, optional Discord notifications, and optional Wikipedia-backed cover-art logo search.
This repository only ships this one application. For support or to report an issue, please use this repository's GitHub Issues.
